facts.note: The nine o'clock watch check, the bell, and Félix's watch reading of twenty minutes to nine all match. But the one who scolds Félix is 'my husband', not Aurèle. Aurèle is named separately as someone else, so the person differs.
Piquet in the salon with the doctor without a break; the temple strikes ten during play; they play on until he goes out for cigars; she did not look at the clock when he left.
As he leaves he asks her to play; she sits at the piano at once, plays until he returns, and stops when he comes in.
'A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.'
